utility.name: Hackerbot Web Client
utility.author: Z. Cliffe Schreuders
utility.description: Installs a minimal browser-based IRC client, served over HTTP (typically from the hackerbot server itself), that connects directly to a private message conversation with hackerbot over ergochat's built-in WebSocket listener. The client's IRC nick is set to the local user's username, and it sends "hello" to the bot automatically as soon as it connects, so the hackerbot conversation starts without the user having to know any IRC commands.
